name: ReviewXpress
author: GDimitrov

sections.description:
ReviewXpress is a full-featured reviews plugin that integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce. Customers can leave detailed reviews with ratings, photos, and videos, while administrators manage everything from a streamlined admin panel.

Key Features

  • WooCommerce integration – Validate reviews against customer orders (optional)
  • Drag & Drop uploader – Easy uploads for photos and videos
  • 5-star rating system – Collect structured feedback
  • Media support – Images (JPG, PNG) and videos (MP4, YouTube)
  • Admin panel – Moderate, edit, and organize reviews
  • Responsive design – Works on all devices
  • AJAX-powered – No page reloads for key actions
  • Automated emails – Send review request links after purchase

Shortcodes

  • [reviewxpress_form product_id="123"] – Review submission form
  • [reviewxpress_list product_id="123"] – Reviews list

Settings

  • Auto-approve reviews (optional)
  • Require WooCommerce order (optional)
  • Allow guest reviews (optional)
  • File and media limits
  • Automated emails for review requests

Support

For support, contact us at support@reviewxpress.com

Privacy Policy

ReviewXpress stores:
– Reviewer name and email
– Review text
– Ratings
– Uploaded images and videos
– Review status

All data is stored locally in your WordPress database and is not shared with third parties.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the reviewxpress folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress “Plugins” menu
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active
  4. Open “ReviewXpress” in the admin menu to configure
  5. Use the shortcodes to display the form and the reviews list
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes, ReviewXpress relies on WooCommerce for full functionality.

Can users without orders leave a review?

Yes. You can allow guest reviews or require a completed order in the settings.

What file types are supported?

Images: JPG, JPEG, PNG. Videos: MP4, MOV, AVI, plus YouTube links.

Can reviews be auto-approved?

Yes, enable auto-approval in the settings.
